name: Dinghy
description: A one-mast boat with oars for when the wind fails. Enough for one or two, a barrel of water and a lot of optimism.

name: Fishing boat
description: A sturdy working boat with a hold that smells of yesterday's catch. Slow, honest and hard to sink.

name: Merchant sloop
description: A fast single-masted trader with room below for cargo and a few passengers.

name: Caravel
description: A three-masted ship built for long voyages: the classic pirate ship, with a figurehead to taste.

name: Galleon
description: A great warship of the high seas, with cannon decks and a crew of dozens. Commands respect in any harbour.

name: Marine warship
description: A Marine battleship with a seastone-lined hull that sea kings cannot sense. Issued by the Marines, or taken from them.
